sentences.en: Logic and mathematics are nothing but specialised linguistic structures.
sentences.zh: 逻辑和数学只不过是特别的语言结构。

sentences.en: A server is a specialised computer.
sentences.zh: 服务器是一种专门的计算机。

sentences.en: She has a lot of experience in specialised medical care for elderly patients.
sentences.zh: 她在老年患者的专业医疗护理方面有很多经验。

senses.zh: 专门的；特别的（等于specialized）v.使专门化；专攻；详细说明（specialise的过去分词）
